name: upgrade-notes-action
description: Posts the vendor's breaking changes, migration notes, deprecations and CVE fixes on every dependency PR, from What's New.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --legal-comments=eof --define:ACTION_VERSION=\"$npm_package_version\" "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.check-dist: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
